about: Game bench: six original game-asset briefs (no character, franchise or brand) and one deliberately bad control, run by scripts/game_bench.py. Each brief names its features in words (the router reads them, and the route the brief was written for), the game exemplar that makes it (form/exemplars/game/<exemplar>.py: its model_mesh ops or kernel source, its materials and its originality note), the engine preset and the triangle budgets (LOD0 first). The control must fail the critic. Budgets and every threshold are proposed values.

briefs.title: Sci-fi helmet prop
briefs.brief: An original sci-fi helmet prop for a shelf in a spaceship level: a rounded shell with a recessed dark visor, raised cheek plates with vents, a crest along the top and panel lines.

features.label: Shell
features.how: smooth styled rounded shell from a subdivision cage

features.label: Visor recess
features.how: a smooth curved visor recessed into the shell cage (inset)

features.label: Cheek plates
features.how: raised smooth cheek plates with vents, cage inset

features.label: Crest
features.how: a raised smooth crest along the top, a creased cage
